name: Fragment's Note 2 Side: Shizuku
source:
The Fragment's Note visual novel series returns with a brand new entry!
Fragment's Note 2 features the deeply moving stories of two new heroines!

Fragment's Note 2 is a slice-of-life visual novel/dating sim featuring
Kyoichi Akikawa, a boy who lost his family in an airplane accident, the
heroines close to him, and the story that binds them together.

[Taken from [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/fragments-note-2/id1107571023?mt=8]iTunes[/url]]
translation:
視覺小說系列《Fragment's Note》攜全新作品歸來！
《Fragment's Note 2》將帶來兩位新女主角感人至深的故事！

《Fragment's Note 2》是一部日常題材的視覺小說兼戀愛模擬遊戲，講述了在空難中失去家人的少年秋河恭一，以及他身邊的女主角們的故事，展現了將他們繫在一起的羈絆。

（摘自[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/fragments-note-2/id1107571023?mt=8]iTunes[/url]）
